title: hieracium cicerbita
intro: Hieracium cicerbita, commonly known as hawkweed or false hawk's beard, is a perennial plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce swelling and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium cicerbita include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve menstrual cramps, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium cicerbita include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
